title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: Notation clash: S denotes both the base scheme (first part of the page) and the vertex set π0(Y) (formula (7)).
Notation clash: σ denotes both the involution σ_Ã and the origin map Ã → S in diagram (8).

The full-faithfulness claim of (6) on the previous page is wrong as stated over a non-reduced base when I ≠ ∅. Grothendieck himself notes this in the margin and proposes the correct fix (work with the pair (X̂, I)).
Minor: the identification π0(Y) ≅ {irreducible components of X} is meant over an algebraically closed field; over a general base π0 must be read relatively, as a finite étale S-scheme.

ideas.what: Equisingular nodal curves over S defined by gluing data (Y smooth proper, Ã with free involution, I marked points); a 'standard curve' is an object in the essential image of the gluing functor
ideas.modern_name: clutching/gluing morphisms; normalization of equisingular nodal families; boundary strata of M̄_{g,n}
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the boundary of M_{g,ν} and the Teichmüller tower informally

ideas.what: Full faithfulness holds only over reduced bases (or over a field) when there are punctures; fix by working with the proper pair (X̂, I) instead of X = X̂ − I
ideas.modern_name: infinitesimal automorphisms of affine curves vs. of marked proper curves; pointed curves as the correct moduli objects

ideas.what: Graph attached to a nodal curve: vertices = components, arcs = branches at nodes with free involution and origin map, edges = nodes, plus legs I → S
ideas.modern_name: dual graph / stable graph with legs (half-edge formalism)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Serre (Arbres, 1977) for the graph formalism; dual graphs of degenerate curves classical (Deligne–Mumford); stable graphs with legs: Kontsevich–Manin, Getzler–Kapranov (1990s)

deep.surprise_reason: This is a careful but standard setup: nodal curves via normalization data, the routine observation that punctured curves are not rigid over non-reduced bases, and the dual graph in Serre's half-edge formalism. All of this is well established in the literature on M̄_{g,n}.
transcription_corrections: Line 1 likely reads 'relation "courbe standard" sur S, tout élément de l'image essentielle': a relative scheme is a standard curve if it is in the essential image.
'"[spectrifié] normalisé" (coeltif) (Grothendieck de langage' is likely '"normalisé" (relatif) (gros abus de langage', with 'système divisant' crossed out.
'puisque ce n'est non seulement' is likely 'puisque ce n'est pas seulement'.

The marginal note plausibly reads: 'Le foncteur est pl. fid. au-dessus d'un corps, ou mieux sur S réduit — faux sur S quelconque (si I ≠ ∅). Pour avoir un foncteur pl. fidèle, il faut dans le contexte propre remplacer X par (X̂, I) de sorte que X = X̂ − I.'
In the marginal note, X̃ should be X̂ (the compactified nodal curve).
